source_origin.vertical_datum: GLB ground mesh, near planar and not surveyed elevation; uncovered cells at local zero

source_fit.method: similarity fit of 939 named OSM buildings (Overpass, way/relation centres) to GLB node bounding-box centres, local equirectangular projection around (51.5145, -0.2240)
source_fit.formula: east,north = equirect(lon,lat; lat0,lon0); [x, -z] = scale * R @ [east, north] + t  (glTF x, z)

alignment.source_datum_correction: The original manifest labels the authored GLB as ENU. Its retained georef.json records a 2.17 degree rotation and translation. This export applies that inverse fit before changing geographic origin; no additional office-local origin is applied.
alignment.placement_accuracy: Recorded georeference fit median residual 1.58 m; not a surveyed building alignment.
alignment.vertical_policy: Unchanged authored relative height; not absolute ODN.
alignment.inherited_layout_limit: office_03 retains the accepted 0.2791 m2 corner discrepancy (up to 0.1801 m outside source slab).
